note: A family groups franchises the owner says share one fictional world. It never merges continuities: each keeps its own lane. same_world only labels a lane as the same world as another; it does not move works. Source: docs/proposals/universe-families.md. 2026-11-24: the comics franchises of Marvel and DC were added to the approved families (owner: "muchos otros de Marvel"); DC is no longer labelled live action. 2026-11-25: Disney / Pixar added at the owner's request as a FAN THEORY (the Pixar Theory and similar), not something the studios confirm. Marvel and Star Wars are Disney-owned but keep their own worlds; The Muppets, Pirates and Indiana Jones are not part of the theory.
